subject: delete the selection on keyboard press in selectInput for easier searching

messages.author: fc439899b88457c2
messages.subject: delete the selection on keyboard press in selectInput for easier searching
parts:
Hi,

The current behaviour of selectInput, when multiple=FALSE is the following: upon a mouse click, cursor appears at the end of current selection. If I want to use keyboard to choose other option from the list, I need to delete the current selection first. Can this behaviour be changed? I.e. I would like that if I clicked on the selectInput and start typing, the search is performed on a string I've entered with no regards to the current selection.

Vaidotas
